arguments.name: Recurrence across records and cultural settings
arguments.position: Strongest conditional case for a shared experiential phenomenon
bridge_principles: Recurrence across different documents, settings and precipitating circumstances can motivate a shared-phenomenon hypothesis when ascertainment and dependence are considered.
To infer brain independence or survival, recurrent motifs would additionally need discriminating evidence ruling out relevant ordinary information and substrate routes.
arguments.conclusion: The inspected records support investigating recurrent experiences with varied content; they do not identify a unique metaphysical cause.
arguments.strongest_objection: Shared human cognition, literary transmission, selection and coding can produce recurrence; no common clinical denominator or assured independent samples.
arguments.strongest_reply: Cultural differences do not refute every shared experiential or survival model, and these narratives predate modern NDE publicity; a constrained model must predict more than broad similarities.
unresolved_issues: No defensible likelihood ratio/posterior; English-access bias; neural timing and independent event verification absent.

arguments.name: Cultural, reporting and measurement countercase
arguments.position: Strongest countercase to invariance and direct survival inference
bridge_principles: Unequal prompts, selected reports and varying labels weaken inferences from narrative frequency to population invariance.
A content difference supports pure cultural causation only if competing physiological, experiential and reporting explanations are discriminated.
arguments.conclusion: Cultural and measurement effects remain serious alternatives; these data neither establish a purely cultural mechanism nor demonstrate a universal afterlife structure.
arguments.strongest_objection: A common experiential or afterlife reality could be interpreted differently by cultures; observational variation need not exhaust the phenomenon.
arguments.strongest_reply: That possibility is retained, but retrospective flexibility earns no distinctive predictive support without prospective constraints.
unresolved_issues: Exposure and translation not independently measured; ordinary mechanisms are possibilities rather than established causes of each episode.
